title: 第 16 章 苏辰道德绑架索要资源第 17 章 伪善嘴脸被我尽收眼底
lines: 晨光铺满陆家朱红院墙，门外仆从匆匆入内通报，说是苏辰带着两名贴身弟子登门拜访，来意不明。陆衍正坐在院中翻看试炼山林的手绘地形图，旁边赵小胖趴在石桌上，一笔一画标注苏辰抱团天骄的落脚点位，前一日敲定双线布局，一边抽空截黑风幽谷灵草，一边筹备三日后宗门小试炼，眼下万事只等苏主动出招。
赵小胖听见通报立马抬起圆脑袋，气呼呼一拍桌子：“这苏辰刚在议事堂白嫖丹药失败，又找上门来，指定没安好心，十有八九又想借着大义薅咱们陆家的修炼资源！”老管家周也眉头紧锁，前些天苏上门虚情假意，转头就到处散播抹黑谣言，吃过一次亏，谁都清楚对方骨子里的贪婪本性。
陆衍合上地图，神色平淡：“来就来了，正好当面拆穿他的道德绑架套路，顺便再收集一份对方索要私产的实证，往后舆论反转全是实打实的证据。”不多时，一身素色长衫的苏辰缓步走入庭院，依旧是那副温润谦和的模样，眉眼带着恰到好处的为难，进门先是对着陆衍拱手行礼，礼数做得滴水不漏，在外人看来妥妥彬彬有礼的寒门天才。
落座寒暄几句闲话，苏没绕太久圈子，很快切入正题，先是长长叹了一口气，摆出一副处境窘迫的模样：“陆师兄，实不相瞒，我修行资源已经快要见底，前些日本想从宗门库房申领丹药，最后意外落空，眼下卡在突破关口，缺高阶淬体丹、上品灵石，寸步难行。”
话音顿了顿，他话锋立马扣上宗门大义的帽子：“我身负全宗门的栽培厚望，未来若是修为大成，能够替青玄宗闯荡秘境、争夺机缘，陆家如今身为宗门顶尖世家，拿出部分资源帮扶，算是为宗门储备栋梁，于公于私都是美事。”
这话表面是商量求助，内里全是胁迫，只要陆家不肯出借资源，立马就能被他扣上漠视宗门发展、打压寒门奇才的大帽子，借着满宗的舆论压力大肆抹黑。苏带来的两名跟班站在身侧适时附和，一唱一和，不断拔高说辞，把索要资源包装成陆家理所应当的义务。
周伯气得手攥紧袖口，想要当场搬出灵泉地契，质问对方霸占祖产在先，凭什么腆脸上门索要资源，被陆衍用眼色悄悄拦下，眼下不急撕破脸皮，先静静听对方把所有绑架话术说完，完整留存言语证据。
苏见陆家众人神色凝重，误以为拿捏住了分寸，继续加码，刻意渲染自己从小到大的穷苦修行经历，从无宗门长辈扶持、没有世家兜底，字字渲染自己一路走来有多不容易，顺带暗戳戳对比陆衍生来坐拥锦衣玉食、海量资源，暗含指责陆家坐拥资源却不肯行善。
周遭几名路过的陆家下人默默驻足旁听，一个个憋着火气，明明自家祖传灵泉被对方强行霸占，对方靠着灵泉白嫖许久修为，如今灵泉灵气回归，转头就上门空手套白狼，天底下再没有这般不讲道理的事，偏偏受天道微弱干扰，下人想要出声辩驳，喉咙微微发紧，话堵在嘴边说不出口。
苏越说越是从容，吃准了舆论大势在自己这边，笃定陆家碍于外界评价不敢强硬翻脸，只要磨上一阵，大概率能蹭走一批高阶丹药。他心中早打好算盘，就算这次索要失败，也能借着登门一事继续在外散播陆家抠门小气、敌视寒门的新谣言，怎么算都不吃亏。
赵小胖憋得脸蛋通红，凑到陆衍耳边压低声音：“少爷，要不直接拿出地契怼死他，把灵泉消耗的资源折算成丹药，反倒让他倒贴咱们！”
陆衍轻轻摇头，现在硬碰硬争吵正中苏下怀，对方正好当场卖惨博取气运，自己要做的是有理有据拆解逻辑，不吵架、不动手，让对方的道德绑架无处落脚。
眼看着苏铺垫完毕，就要正式开口敲定丹药数目，陆衍缓缓开口，不疾不徐，第一句话就直击要害：“苏师弟开口要陆家资源帮扶，先算一笔旧账，陆家祖传先天灵泉被你占据多日，泉眼每日产出灵液折算淬体丹不下千枚，这么大一笔资源落在你身上，怎么从没见你主动结算、归还？”
苏脸色微微一僵，没想到陆不顺着资源的话题拉扯，直接扯出灵旧事，仓促辩解：“灵泉乃是天降机缘，机缘归属凭自身气运，怎能折算财物？”
“玄洲宗门律法白纸黑字，私人封地之内出产一切宝物、灵脉，全归地契持有者所有。”陆衍慢悠悠取出随身携带的地契副本平铺石桌，“机缘落在别人私地，强行占有本就不合规矩，既然你认定机缘所得不用归还，那凭什么伸手索要陆家库存丹药？”
一句话堵得苏哑口无言，先前准备好的一堆大义说辞瞬间卡在喉咙里，精心布置的道德绑架套路刚起头就被撕开缺口。他慌忙改换说辞，改口称灵泉修炼所得全都用来夯实根基、为宗门变强，算不上私人牟利，试图继续绕弯子。陆紧跟着层层拆解，细数苏霸占灵泉期间私下克扣陆家仆役月钱、纵容手下寻衅滋事的一件件实事，人证全都已经备好，随时可以传唤到场。
苏身旁两名跟班脸色大变，再也没法帮腔，原本气势十足的索要场面彻底崩盘，苏脸上温和的面具一点点裂开，再也维持不住大度人设，心底又气又急，可找不到半句合理反驳的话语。天道此刻还想帮苏倾斜气运，可陆衍身上连日积攒的功德金光自发形成微弱屏障，稀释掉大半天意加持，苏没法像从前那样靠随口卖惨疯狂吸金。
僵持半个时辰，苏实在讨不到半点好处，再耗下去反倒把自己贪婪面目暴露得彻彻底底，只能强行挤出几分尴尬笑意，借口还有宗门事务，带着跟班狼狈匆匆告辞。走出陆家大门的瞬间，苏立马阴沉着脸吩咐手下，继续在外编造谣言，宣称陆衍心胸狭隘、不顾宗门大局，连助力天才的一点丹药都舍不得拿出，新一轮抹黑言论即将在宗门各处蔓延开来。
赵看着苏走远的背影拍手叫好：“总算把这小子怼跑了，这回他啥好处没捞着，反倒白白暴露贪心！”周伯悬着的心也落了大半，连连赞叹少爷谈吐条理，换做从前的纨绔原主，早就当场暴怒动手，正中对方圈套。
陆衍没有放松警惕，苏吃瘪之后绝不会善罢甘休，定然会靠着谣言造势，后续宗门不少中立弟子又要被天道潜移默化带偏想法。他当即吩咐小胖全天盯紧苏跟班的造谣动向，把各处散播的不实言论一一记录在案，全部留作后续舆论反转的铁证。
忙活大半日，转眼暮色降临，陆收拾行装，准备当夜悄悄动身奔赴黑风幽谷，趁着夜色隐秘潜入，借用地底暗渠绕开苏布下的外围警戒阵法，截胡百年凝气灵草。就在整装完毕、即将动身之际，系统提示音突兀响起。【预警：苏预判陆会暗中前往幽谷夺宝，暗中联系两名内门心腹埋伏在暗渠出入口，布下陷阱守株待兔，等着陆贸然闯入就当场抓包，反扣偷盗机缘罪名！】

The morning light covered the red courtyard wall of the Lu family, and the servants outside the door hurried inside to announce that Su Chen came to visit with two of his personal disciples, and the purpose of their visit was unknown. Lu Yan was sitting in the courtyard looking through the hand-drawn topographic map of the trial mountain forest. Next to him, Fatty Zhao was lying on the stone table, marking the location of Su Chen's group of geniuses one stroke at a time. The day before, he had finalized the two-line layout and took the time to intercept the Black Wind Valley Spirit Grass while preparing for the sect's small trial in three days. All things were now waiting for Su to take the initiative.
When Zhao Xiaopang heard the announcement, he immediately raised his round head and slapped the table angrily: "This Su Chen just failed to buy pills for free in the council hall, and he came to the door again. He has no good intentions and most likely wants to use his righteousness to steal us. Our Lu family's training resources!" Old housekeeper Zhou Ye frowned. A few days ago, Su came to visit and spread false rumors. After suffering a loss, everyone knew the greedy nature of the other party.
Lu Yan closed the map and said with a calm expression: "I'm here as soon as I can, just in time to expose his moral kidnapping scheme in person, and collect a piece of evidence that the other party asked for private property. The public opinion will turn around in the future. It's all solid evidence." Not long after, a man wearing plain clothes and long clothes Su Chen, who was wearing a shirt, walked slowly into the courtyard, still looking gentle and modest, with just the right amount of embarrassment in his eyebrows. When he entered the door, he bowed his hands and saluted Lu Yan. The etiquette was impeccable, and in the eyes of outsiders, he was a well-mannered genius from a humble family.
After sitting down and chatting for a few words, Su didn't go around for too long and quickly got to the point. First, he let out a long sigh and looked like he was in a difficult situation: "Senior Brother Lu, to be honest, my cultivation resources are almost at the bottom. I tried to apply for elixirs from the sect's warehouse in Japan, but unexpectedly failed. Now I am stuck at the breakthrough point. I lack high-level body tempering elixirs and high-grade spiritual stones, so I can't move forward."
There was a pause in his words, and he immediately labeled the sect's righteousness as his words: "I have high hopes for the cultivation of the whole sect. If I achieve great success in the future, I can enter the secret realm and compete for opportunities for the Qingxuan Sect. The Lu family is now the top family of the sect, and they have allocated part of their resources to help. It can be regarded as a reserve of pillars for the sect. It is a good thing for both public and private affairs."
On the surface, this was a request for help, but on the inside, it was all coercion. As long as the Lu family refused to lend resources, he would immediately be labeled as indifferent to the development of the sect and suppress the talented people from poor families, and he would use the pressure of public opinion from the sect to smear him. The two followers brought by Su stood beside him and echoed in time, singing along and constantly elevating the rhetoric, packaging the request for resources as a legitimate obligation of the Lu family.
Uncle Zhou was so angry that he clenched his sleeves and wanted to move out of the Lingquan land deed on the spot. He asked the other party why he was so shy when he came to ask for resources before he took over the ancestral property. Lu Yan quietly stopped him with a look. He was not in a hurry to show off his face at the moment. He quietly listened to the other party finish all the kidnapping words and kept all the verbal evidence.
Seeing the dignified expressions of everyone in the Lu family, Su mistakenly thought that he was being careful, so he continued to increase the pressure, deliberately exaggerating his poor cultivation experience from childhood to adulthood, never having the support of the elders of the sect, and having no aristocratic family to back him up.
Several servants of the Lu family who were passing by stopped to listen silently. They were all holding back their anger. It was clear that their ancestral spiritual spring was forcibly occupied by the other party. The other party had relied on the spiritual spring for a long time to cultivate. Now that the spiritual energy of the spiritual spring has returned, he turned around and came to the door empty-handed. There is no such unreasonable thing in the world. However, due to the weak interference of the law of heaven, the servant wanted to argue loudly, but his throat was slightly tight and the words were stuck in his mouth.
Su Yue said the more calmly he was, knowing that the general trend of public opinion was on his side. He was sure that the Lu family did not dare to turn against them due to external criticism. As long as they worked hard for a while, they would most likely be able to get rid of a batch of high-end elixirs. He had already calculated in his mind that even if his request failed this time, he could still use the visit to spread new rumors that the Lu family was stingy and hostile to poor families, and he would not suffer any loss no matter what.
Zhao Xiaopang's face turned red from holding back, and he leaned into Lu Yan's ear and lowered his voice: "Master, why don't we just take out the land deed and kill him, convert the resources consumed by Lingquan into pills, and make him turn to us instead!"
Lu Yan shook his head slightly. The head-to-head argument was playing into Su's heart. The other party was just doing something cruel on the spot to gain luck. What he had to do was to dismantle the logic with reason and evidence, without arguing or taking action, so that the other party's moral kidnapping had no place to settle.
Seeing that Su had finished laying the groundwork and was about to formally decide on the number of pills, Lu Yan spoke slowly, without any delay, and hit the point directly with his first sentence: "Junior brother Su asked for Lu family resources to help. Let's settle an old score first. The Lu family's ancestral innate spiritual spring has been occupied by you for many days. The spring produces spiritual liquid every day, which can be converted into no less than a thousand body tempering pills. Such a large amount of resources falls on you, why have you never taken the initiative to settle and return it?"
Su's expression froze slightly. Unexpectedly, Lu Bu followed the topic of resources and directly brought up the old story of Ling. He hurriedly defended: "Lingquan is a chance from heaven. The opportunity belongs to one's own luck. How can it be converted into property?"
"The laws of the Xuanzhou Sect are written in black and white. All treasures and spiritual veins produced within the private fiefdom belong to the land deed holder." Lu Yan slowly took out the copy of the land deed that he carried with him and laid it on the stone table. "By chance, it falls on someone else's private land. Forcibly occupying it is against the rules. Since you believe that the income obtained by chance does not need to be returned, why do you ask for the pills in the Lu family's inventory?"
Su was speechless with one sentence, and the pile of righteous rhetoric he had prepared earlier was instantly stuck in his throat, and the carefully arranged moral kidnapping routine was torn open at the beginning. He hurriedly changed his rhetoric and said that all the proceeds from Lingquan's cultivation were used to consolidate the foundation and make the sect stronger, and it was not considered personal gain, so he tried to continue to beat around the bush. Lu followed the dismantling step by step, detailing the fact that during Su's occupation of Lingquan, he secretly deducted monthly payments from the Lu family's servants and allowed his subordinates to pick fights and cause trouble. All witnesses were ready and could be summoned to the scene at any time.
The expressions of the two followers beside Su changed greatly, and they could no longer help. The originally vigorous requesting scene completely collapsed. The gentle mask on Su's face cracked bit by bit, and he could no longer maintain his generous persona. He was angry and anxious in his heart, but could not find any reasonable rebuttal. At this moment, Heaven still wanted to help Su change his luck, but the golden light of merit accumulated over the past few days on Lu Yan's body formed a weak barrier, diluting most of Heaven's blessing. Su could not make money like before by selling misery casually.
The stalemate lasted for half an hour, but Su couldn't get any benefit at all, and if he spent any more time, his greedy face would be completely exposed. He could only force out a somewhat embarrassed smile, excuse himself from the sect's affairs, and hurriedly left with his followers in embarrassment. The moment he walked out of the gate of the Lu family, Su immediately ordered his men with a sullen face to continue fabricating rumors outside, claiming that Lu Yan was narrow-minded, disregarded the overall interests of the sect, and was reluctant to even take out a little pill to help the genius. A new round of slanderous remarks was about to spread throughout the sect.
Zhao looked at Su's walking back and clapped his hands and applauded: "Finally, I got rid of this kid. This time he didn't get any benefits, but his greed was exposed in vain!" Uncle Zhou's heart dropped for the most part, and he repeatedly praised the young master for his well-organized conversation. The former owner of the playboy would have been angry and struck on the spot, and fell into the opponent's trap.
Lu Yan did not let down his guard. He would never give up after Su was defeated. He would definitely rely on rumors to build momentum. In the future, many neutral disciples of the sect would be subtly influenced by the way of heaven. He immediately ordered Xiaopang to keep an eye on Su's followers' rumor-mongering activities throughout the day, record the false statements spread everywhere, and keep them all as irrefutable evidence for the subsequent reversal of public opinion.
After working for most of the day, dusk fell in a blink of an eye. Lu packed his bags and prepared to quietly leave for the Black Wind Valley that night. He would sneak in secretly under the cover of night and use underground channels to bypass the outer warning formation under Su Bu and cut off the century-old Qi Condensing Spirit Grass. Just when the outfit was completed and about to set off, the system beep sounded suddenly. [Early Warning: Su predicted that Lu would secretly go to the deep valley to seize the treasure, secretly contacted two inner sect confidants to ambush at the entrance and exit of the culvert, laid a trap and waited, and when Lu unexpectedly broke in, he would seize the bag on the spot and charge him with stealing the opportunity! 】
